input_rule: All twelve prepared MXL scores, including the three with embedded harmony elements removed, are passed byte-for-byte to both analyzers. Gold comes only from the paired primary analysis.txt. All prepared inputs were hash-verified and accepted by both parsers where stripping occurred before gold was opened.

candidate.option: The opt-in rule may add a downbeat label from an exact tertian chord in the first half of a valid aligned bar; the default vertical analysis is unchanged.

evaluator.gold_positions: RomanText parser's primary analysis.txt measure and beat, mapped to the common score's physical measure index; duplicated source positions are excluded as ambiguous.
evaluator.alignment: Compare complete pitched onset, duration, and MIDI-pitch multisets per physical measure. Acorde tuplet durations are accumulated as exact fractions before final six-decimal comparison. Exclude unequal or ambiguously mapped measures before inspecting either prediction.
evaluator.normalization: Whitespace, percent/half-diminished glyph, degree/diminished glyph, and 42/2 third-inversion spelling only. Retain chromatic spelling, applied chords, quality, root, inversion, and key distinctions.
evaluator.comparison_task: Roman figure at each aligned primary-annotation position. Predictions away from those positions are outside this task and are not credited or penalized.

decision.coverage_gate: Both systems must receive all twelve prepared inputs; Acorde's parsed-case count must be at least music21's, and at least 90 percent of all parsed primary source labels must align for paired scoring. Report every excluded label and reason.
decision.superiority_gate: On the same aligned gold positions, Acorde must have strictly more correct canonical Roman figures and no lower exact-position precision than music21. The result is task-scoped, not overall music-analysis superiority.
decision.stop_rule: Run once with this candidate and these evaluator sources. If any result or score informs a fix, reclassify the entire cohort as development and freeze a new disjoint untouched holdout before another superiority claim.
